subject: ddply: problems with pieces with different length

messages.subject: ddply: problems with pieces with different length
parts:
Hi there
 
I have the following dataset, sorted by masterid and days.after.nadir:
 
   masterid days.after.nadir
1        17             1392
2        17             1574
3        17             1933
4        17             2313
5        17             2428
6        63              115
7        63              178
8        63              235
9        63              327
10       63              332
11       63              409
12       67               79
13       67              230
14       90               52
15       90              206
16       90              283
17       90              441
18       90              538
19       90              542
20      104             1253
21      104             1443
22      104             1631
23      104             1826
24      104             1946
25      104             1982
26      104             2024
27      104             2081
28      104             2257
29      104             2355
30      104             2473
...
 
so I'd like to create a new column, with a "zeroed offset" -- i.e. for each group defined by masterid, I'd like to substract the days.after.nadir from its min value, so in this new column it should start in zero for each first row of every different masterid. Each masterid may have a different number of rows!
 
So I wrote the following code:
 
library(plyr)
zerodays <- function (df) {
            zeroed.offset <- df$days.after.nadir - min(df$days.after.nadir)
            }
 
dataset <- ddply(dataset,.(masterid),zerodays)
 
I thought it'd be enough to bind the group-wise computation of the function into a new column. But I received an error message (because of the variable length of the pieces of the splitted dataset, I believe).
 
Error in list_to_dataframe(res, attr(.data, "split_labels")) :
  Results do not have equal lengths
 
How could I complete this task using the plyr package ?
 
I'll appreciate your help. Thanks !
 
Roberto L Muller

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: ddply: problems with pieces with different length
parts:
Roberto, I think you need to use transform: 
dat <- read.table(textConnection("   masterid days.after.nadir

zeroed.offset <- df - min(df)
            }
 
dataset <- ddply(dat,.(masterid),transform, zeroed.offset = zerodays(days.after.nadir))

HTH
Luciano


2011/4/14 Roberto Lodeiro Muller <robertolod...@gmail.com>

library(plyr)
zerodays <- function (df) {
            zeroed.offset <- df$days.after.nadir - min(df$days.after.nadir)
            }
 
dataset <- ddply(dataset,.(masterid),zerodays)
